summary: The audit checks the first-year seminars (OCEANS 300A-C) and workshops (OCEANS 301 and 305), the second-year workshops (OCEANS 303 and 304), and 135 units, every course letter graded when a letter grade is offered. Checked by hand: the 3.0 GPA, 3 units with each of four Stanford faculty, the TA appointment and service, the research requirement in the Oceans Handbook, the two-part qualifying exam, candidacy, the oral exam and the dissertation.

program.why: Grading: "If offered, any course that satisfies the PhD degree requirements must be taken for a letter grade."

In addition to the program requirements listed above, this total may be satisfied by: seminar units, research units (e.g., OCEANS 300) ..." The 135 is program.unitsMin; OCEANS 300 is an example, not a required course.
